title: Animated Drawer
subtitle: A panel that slides in from the edge and can be swiped away.

descriptions.rollingText: The trigger and button labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.fillOnHover: Buttons fill with colour from the edge on hover.
descriptions.side: Which edge of the screen the drawer slides in from.
descriptions.showSwipeHandle: Shows a handle you can grab to swipe the drawer away.
descriptions.openAnimation: How the drawer arrives: slides in or fades in.
descriptions.elastic: The drawer springs in with a slight overshoot.
descriptions.duration: How long the open animation takes, in seconds.
descriptions.bounce: How much the drawer overshoots and settles. 0 is no bounce.
descriptions.stagger: Delay between each piece of drawer content appearing, in seconds.
descriptions.tiltOnSwipe: The drawer tilts slightly as you swipe it.
descriptions.scaleBackground: The page behind shrinks a little while the drawer is open.
